en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a riverside view of a town nestled between hills. The foreground features a body of water, likely a river, bordered by a stone embankment. Behind the river are rows of houses with red-tiled roofs, a distinctive church or civic building with a dome, and more buildings in the background, with hills rising on both sides. In the bottom right foreground stands a man dressed in early 20th-century formal attire. The sky is cloudy and the whole scene has an old-fashioned, hand-tinted look. At the top of the postcard, there is printed text in Romanian.
